title: CoBeART shared configuration
description: Role values reference the contract role enum (contract/frame.schema.json), so validators must register that schema first. Rules a schema cannot express (roles unique across tracking.roles, sources.mouse.z_initial_mm inside arena.z) are checked by both loaders.

client_address.description: IPv4 address of the CoBe computer.

server_address.description: IPv4 address of the OptiTrack (Motive) computer.

host.description: Hub bind address and client target host.

use_optitrack_client.description: Use the OptiTrack client to compute agent coordinates.

tracking_framerate.description: Hz, rate at which data is received from OptiTrack.

package_framerate.description: Hz, rate at which pose_frames are sent to the hub.

x_rescale.description: Arena length along x in meters, used to rescale coordinates.

y_rescale.description: Arena length along y in meters, used to rescale coordinates.

roles.description: Motive streaming ID (non-negative integer key) to contract role; each role at most once. The OptiTrack source drops IDs not listed here.

arena.description: Arena bounds in millimeters as [min, max].

metrics.description: The hub's velocity stage (derived frame fields, per role).

max_vel.description: mm/s, abs_vel that maps to norm_abs_vel = 1.

history_window.description: Number of samples in the norm_abs_vel hold window.

max_gap_s.description: Seconds of source time; a longer gap between two poses of a role restarts its motion state.

audio_max_age_ms.description: Milliseconds after which the bridge treats the latest audio as stale and posts audio: null.

role.description: Role the held mouse button acts as.

z_initial_mm.description: mm, height before the first wheel notch; must lie inside arena.z.

z_step_mm.description: mm, height change per wheel notch, clamped to arena.z.

rate_hz.description: Hz, pose_frame rate while a button is held.

sample_rate.description: Hz, used when the device default is unavailable.

beat_detection.description: Enable beat detection (default on per D4).
